blockers: Playfield lamps 1-32 and 49-54 have no placement: none of the three retained Cyclone tables models a lamp bulb. vpmMapLights binds every lamp to insert-overlay lights (lNa, lNa1) that set no bulb mesh, and the COMET lamps 27-32 sit on the table's back panel above the playfield. A table that models the insert bulbs, or the manual's lamp drawing (PDF 43) measured balloon by balloon, would place them.

Flasher circuits 9 (Spins Mystery Wheel), 15 (Boomerang, three #1251 lamps), 25, 26, 27, 28 and 32 have no placement, and 29 and 30 have one of their two playfield bulbs placed: the retained tables light these through lights with no flasher dome on the playfield (27's dome Flasher27p and 30's Flasher30p stand on the back panel above the playfield), and 9 has no light at all.
No placement has been checked against the manual's numbered switch (PDF 40), lamp (PDF 43) and solenoid (PDF 44) drawings with a callout check, so every table placement stays observed.
Solenoid 10 (playfield G.I.): the placements are the 32 bulb-modelling lights of the table's GI collection; the manual prints no G.I. bulb count or layout, so they stay observed without a quantity.
coordinate_convention: x=0 left, x=1 right; y=0 rear/backglass, y=1 apron; normalized VPX/player view
excluded_objects: Insert-overlay lights lNa and lNa1 that vpmMapLights binds to the playfield lamps: no bulb mesh
Lights L27-L32 and the COMET overlays on the back panel, and l57-l64 on the backglass, above or behind the playfield
GILight32-34, GILight36-38 and the GI2 plastic lights: GI-collection lights that model no bulb
Flasher domes Flasher27p and Flasher30p and their lights on the back panel at y < 0, off the playfield plane
Lights F25, F25b, F26, F28, F29b-F29d, F30b-F30d, F31b, F32-F32c and Flash15a-c: no flasher dome or bulb

projections.disclosure: The Boomerang Kickbig coil sits under the kickbig its switch 13 reports; the placement is the sw13 kicker the script both reads and kicks.
The drop-target reset coil sits under the target; the placement is the Sw18 drop target it raises.

The Ferris wheel motor is part of the C-11900 Ferris Wheel/Motor Assembly; the placement is the position of the table's RedWheel primitive, the wheel its FWTimer rotates. Where the motor sits in the assembly is not printed.

The Switches list gives the left lane-change switch its own part (B-9951-1) apart from the cabinet Flipper Button (SW-10A-48), and the switch drawing's (PDF 40) balloon 57 points at the left flipper's pivot, so it is placed at the table's LeftFlipper pivot; where on the flipper assembly the switch is mounted is not printed. A consumer drives 84, not 57.

The Switches list gives the right lane-change switch its own part (B-9951) apart from the cabinet Flipper Button (SW-10A-48), and the switch drawing's (PDF 40) balloon 58 points at the right flipper's pivot, so it is placed at the table's RightFlipper pivot; where on the flipper assembly the switch is mounted is not printed. A consumer drives 82, not 58.
